title: Group words that are anagrams
summary: Every word goes into a pigeonhole labelled with its letter counts; words sharing a pigeonhole are anagrams of each other.
goal: Put words made of the same letters into the same group

mapping.formal: A key shared by all anagrams

examples.label: An empty word
examples.explanation: The empty word forms its own group.

ladder.name: Compare with every group
ladder.idea: For each word, check it against one word from every existing group and join the first that is an anagram.

ladder.name: Label by sorted letters
ladder.idea: Sort each word's letters to make its label, and collect words under their label in a map.
ladder.insight: Anagrams become identical when their letters are sorted, so the sorted word is a label all anagrams share.

ladder.name: Label by letter counts
ladder.idea: Use the count of each of the 26 letters as the label instead of sorting.
ladder.insight: Counting the letters of a word takes one pass, while sorting takes k log k, and the counts identify anagrams just as well.

transfer.problem: Group shopping baskets that contain exactly the same items in any order.
transfer.explanation: Give each basket a signature that ignores order, such as its sorted items, and group baskets by signature.

selfCheck: Uses a label that is identical for anagrams and different otherwise.
Collects words in a map keyed by label.
Keeps every word, including duplicates and empty words.
Returns the groups, in any order.
